verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a policy or setting stating that customer trace data is excluded from AI model training. The only lever is indirect: Langfuse is MIT-licensed open source and can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure with all core features, which keeps data under the user's control. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment for Langfuse Cloud, a documented opt-out control, and independent corroboration of data-use practices.
